statusDefinitions.ok: Sufficient price history exists to compute the frozen 120-trading-day outcome.
statusDefinitions.insufficient_history: The security did not have enough post-cutoff trading history for the frozen horizon.
statusDefinitions.delisted: Security delisted during the horizon; retain it in the denominator.
statusDefinitions.suspended: Trading suspension prevents a standard outcome calculation; retain it in the denominator.
statusDefinitions.price_missing: Required market data could not be retrieved or verified; retain it in the denominator.
statusDefinitions.execution_blocked: Frozen entry rule was not executable; retain the case for later execution_filtered classification.
